decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the core offer and is still presented on its own page; in a growing industry with ample slack it gives no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses.
The HERA launch with the firm's Asteroid Framing Camera on board is proven mission performance that exceeds the aspiration, so keeping this modular product line is clearly favored.
Space situational awareness is a growing field, the suite still has its own page, and the firm's slack lets it carry results that are still uncertain.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned and shows no reported results, but it fits the firm's push toward compact sensors for small satellites, and slack allows patience during long space qualification cycles.

This product line was launched only in 2024 and is prominently presented, so it is too early to judge it against the aspiration, and dropping it would forgo the investment already made in qualification.
The asteroid camera is tied to the HERA mission heritage, which signals success, even though it is only mentioned on the website and its market is niche.
